issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 5 unused public symbols in axe desired_state/lifecycle_journal and bead-touches widget
issue.description: Found while splitting src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_notification_utils.py. After the split's private-import errors were fixed, just _lint-symvision fails with Unused public functions/classes for 5 symbols in files untouched by the split: AxeDesiredState in src/sase/axe/desired_state.py; bead_touch_glyph and ordered_bead_verb_chips in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_bead_touches.py; lifecycle_journal_path and read_recent_successful_starts in src/sase/axe/lifecycle_journal.py. Fix per sase memory read symvision.md: make each private if only used in its own file (test-only references do not count), delete if dead, no pragmas.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static linter failure, not intermittent: symvision reports the same 5 unused-public symbols on every run. The flagged files are byte-identical to HEAD (only the notification-split files differ in the tree), and the split added no references to these symbols, so the failure is independent of the in-progress split work.
